scope: Algebraic decomposition of each retained whole-window voltage maximum: C(t)-F(t) = C(t)-I_C[F](t) + I_C[F](t)-F(t), where I_C samples the fine piecewise-linear curve at the enclosing coarse knots. Both reference directions are retained. The second term measures resampling of the selected curve; the first retains endpoint-value disagreement, which can itself include interpolation of the reference. Attribution depends on the reference direction and signed cancellation is preserved. The fine curve is not ground truth, so neither term bounds physical error or justifies subtracting anything from acceptance. No time alignment or omitted peak.
